name: Seravis
source:
"I hate useless people and situations. ...Now, what do you think? Still want to hear more?"

The second in command of Deeks. Rowe's boss.
He's in command of the finances of the organization and doesn't participate in the fighting, but apparently he's a strange magician.
An expressionless guy who doesn't think of the protagonist as anything but luggage.
